Built off of, updated, and expanded from Shurik1236's original [Fluff-Kevlar] Art Collection, as seen here https://e-hentai.org/g/3112390/cf4aa42dc0/

This collection contains two folders, one with all content Fluff-Kevlar has ever created and released up to June 2026 in one folder (originally by Shurik1236 and updated up to now), and another folder with all known Fluff-Kevlar fan art by other artists.

I intend to update this torrent semi-annually, every June and every January of the year with new content updates from both Fluff-Kevlar and any and all fan art of his characters.

A live archive of all of this content is also being uploaded on the Permanent Booru, accessible via Tor, linked here http://owmvhpxyisu6fgd7r2fcswgavs7jly4znldaey33utadwmgbbp4pysad.onion/

This archive includes any and all paid content by or involving Fluff-kevlar or his characters. This is not intended to be an insult or to deprive him of income, but is in fact out of respect and love for his characters and the worlds he has built, and to make it as accessible to those who seek it out as possible, in order to help his fanbase and franchise organically grow and become more popular, which would actually increase FK's total potential income as a result. I am releasing this as a way to both liberate it from behind its paywall, and as a way to get more eyes on the artwork itself, making his franchise more popular. From a purely economic standpoint, this is eliminating the deadweight loss of the artwork. Since no potential profit can be lost from someone who will, by default, never pay for something that costs $0 to reproduce or distribute, but manages to obtain it without paying regardless, the total potential harm of them doing so is $0. However in reality, this is not the end of the story, because when non-paying users get to experience high quality content for free, they inevitably begin to talk about it with others, start creating fan art, and participating in its proliferation more and more, which causes others who actually are willing to pay to also end up finding it. Eventually, even the pirates themselves may begin to leave the what would otherwise be the deadweight loss zone of the supply and demand graph and voluntarily become paying customers out of a genuine sense of love and appreciation for the artwork, and by extension, the artist. It is in this way that I, ColonelKernel, mean to redistribute this content freely with only the best of intentions, and in no way do so out of malice or disrespect. If you liked this collection please consider passing a few dollars FK's way on either Patreon or SubscribeStar, if not for the content itself, then out of appreciation for the artist!

FK is also a really nice guy and while he obviously can't be expected to support piracy of his own content, he also isn't particularly offended by our swashbuckling ways either and understands why we do it, seeing it as inevitable. On rare occasions he even drops in to chat and visit on our u18chan thread sometimes where we drop his content when it releases.

if you want to talk or fight or whatever you can find me at t.me/colonelkernell, enjoy!
